bills.title: Wage Justice for Early Childhood Education and Care Workers (Special Account) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted against [Greens amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-11-26.318.1), which were introduced by Victorian Senator [Steph Hodgins-May](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/steph_hodgins-may) (Greens). The amendments would have increased the wage increase to 25%. ### Amendment text > *(1) Clause 11, page 6 (lines 20 to 23), omit paragraph (3)(a), substitute:* > >> *(a) include provisions to permit amounts paid to the recipient under the grant to be used in relation to the remuneration of workers, who are within a class specified in the agreement for this purpose, that is at least 25% above the worker's current remuneration; and*
